CheckTitle: IAM role trusting GitHub Actions OIDC restricts subjects to specific repository owners
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Description: An IAM role trusting GitHub Actions OIDC restricts `token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub` to a non-wildcard repository owner. The repository may be specific (`repo:<owner>/<repo>:*`) or wildcarded (`repo:<owner>/*:*`).
Risk: Without a trusted-owner constraint, workflows from repositories owned by untrusted GitHub accounts may assume the role and use its AWS permissions.

Code.NativeIaC:
```yaml
Resources:
  example_resource:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:oidc-provider/token.actions.githubusercontent.com'
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub: repo:ORG/REPOSITORY:* # Restrict to this repository
```
Code.Other:
1. Open IAM > Roles and select the role.
2. Edit its trust policy so every GitHub Actions OIDC statement restricts `token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub` to an approved `repo:<owner>/<repository>:...` value.
3. Save the policy and retain all other required statements.

Recommendation.Text: Restrict GitHub Actions OIDC trust to repositories and owners that your organization controls.

Notes: This check only passes trust policies that constrain `token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub` using the `repo:<owner>/<repository>:...` format. Policies using `token.actions.githubusercontent.com:repository_owner` or a custom GitHub OIDC subject, such as `repository_owner_id:...`, are outside the pass criteria and will be reported as FAIL. Configure `iam_github_oidc_allowed_owners` to restrict the check to an owner allowlist; an empty list preserves the default behavior.
